changes: 🎰 Live Blackjack polish: buy-in is now a real chip rail (tap chips to build an amount, Sit Down / Cancel) instead of a plain prompt() dialog, using the same chip-colour styling as the single-player Blackjack bet panel. Table Chat added, on its own /blackjackChat path. Table creator or admin can now delete a table, with every seated player automatically refunded first.

🐛 Two real mistakes caught and fixed while building this: an admin-check that read an unreliable /users field instead of the verified session's own email (same class of bug already caught once before elsewhere), and an architecture mistake where a second function export wouldn't actually have been reachable as its own endpoint — folded into the main handler instead of shipping something broken.

🔧 Fixed the actual Hold'em issue reported: a table stuck with status permanently at 'hand_in_progress' blocked deletion for everyone, admin included — there was no way to ever clear it. Admin now has a guaranteed-working force-delete path that goes straight through blackjack-table-dealer.mjs's own logic rather than depending on holdem-dealer.mjs's, so it can't be blocked by whatever was actually causing the original problem.
